description: Ten original IT helpdesk cases written by the team: five single-turn cases and five multi-turn cases covering routing, missing information, cancellation, and confirmation boundaries.

cases.query: Laptop Windows cua toi khong ket noi duoc Wi-Fi cong ty. Cho toi huong dan xu ly.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes a Windows Wi-Fi troubleshooting request to the knowledge base.

cases.query: Kiem tra trang thai dich vu VPN trong moi truong staging.

metadata.what_it_tests: Preserves an explicit non-production environment in the status lookup.

cases.query: Hay kiem tra bao mat cho thiet bi LT-204.

metadata.what_it_tests: Uses the supplied asset ID and requested security check without guessing another device.

cases.query: Tra cuu thong tin ho tro cua nhan vien EMP-1042.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes an explicit employee directory request to lookup_user.

cases.query: Ban co the ho tro nhung viec gi trong bo phan IT?

metadata.what_it_tests: Answers a capability question without making an unrelated lookup or diagnostic call.

turns.content: Toi khong dang nhap duoc vao he thong khi lam viec tu nha.
Loi nay xay ra khi ket noi VPN tren Windows.
Hay tim huong dan xu ly cho toi.

metadata.what_it_tests: Uses the latest clarified VPN context from earlier turns to search the relevant guidance.

turns.content: Dich vu cua toi dang gap loi.
Hay kiem tra trang thai giup toi.

metadata.what_it_tests: Requests the service choice instead of guessing which service to inspect.

turns.content: May in cua toi bi hong va toi can IT ho tro.
Tao ticket uu tien medium giup toi, nhung hay hoi xac nhan truoc.
Toi xac nhan tao ticket voi noi dung tren.

metadata.what_it_tests: Creates a ticket only after the user explicitly confirms the previously discussed request.

turns.content: Toi muon tao ticket vi khong truy cap duoc email.
Thoi, toi khong muon tao ticket nua. Chi cho toi biet cach tu xu ly.

metadata.what_it_tests: Honors a later cancellation and does not create a ticket after the request is withdrawn.

turns.content: May tinh cua toi cham va hay bi dung.
Hay chay kiem tra phan cung cho may tinh nay.

metadata.what_it_tests: Asks for the asset ID before inspecting a device instead of inventing one.
